{{Top|leg}}
'''Savvlock's School of Big Business''' was an educational institute who prepared businessmen for operating in various underworld activities in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Gandin T'Noull]], the manager of the [[Ace of Sabres]], gained his degree from this institute.
